limits: SAM scores are predicted mask-quality scores, not measured ground-truth IoU.
GPU allocated peaks include resident tensors and inference allocations, not driver context, other processes or reserved-only memory.
Timed runs exclude checkpoint download, Python startup and pre-timer input verification/decoding.
No CPU fallback was necessary in the real runs; mocked tests exercise it.
Only visualization uses the highest SAM score. All three mask PNGs and their overlays are preserved per experiment.
No mask clipping, hole filling, morphology or manual mask correction was applied to saved binary masks. Edge dilation/erosion is display-only.

Post-run hardening only: failed-CUDA-attempt telemetry, strict invalid-config checks, binding exact copied input bytes, and null resolved revision when loading fails. No successful model or mask computation changed; no inference rerun was needed for these paths.
